symbols.name: Whole note
symbols.explanation: Note lasting four beats in common time.

symbols.name: Half note
symbols.explanation: Note lasting two beats in common time.

symbols.name: Quarter note
symbols.explanation: Note lasting one beat in common time.

symbols.name: Eighth note
symbols.explanation: Note lasting half a beat in common time.

symbols.name: Beamed eighth notes
symbols.explanation: Two connected eighth notes.

symbols.name: Beamed sixteenth notes
symbols.explanation: Four connected sixteenth notes.

symbols.name: Sixteenth note
symbols.explanation: Note lasting a quarter of a beat in common time.

symbols.name: Thirty second note
symbols.explanation: Note shorter than a sixteenth note.

symbols.name: Sixty fourth note
symbols.explanation: Very short note value.

symbols.name: Hundred twenty eighth note
symbols.explanation: Extremely short note value used rarely.

symbols.name: Whole rest
symbols.explanation: Silence lasting four beats in common time.

symbols.name: Half rest
symbols.explanation: Silence lasting two beats in common time.

symbols.name: Quarter rest
symbols.explanation: Silence lasting one beat in common time.

symbols.name: Eighth rest
symbols.explanation: Silence lasting half a beat in common time.

symbols.name: Sixteenth rest
symbols.explanation: Silence lasting a quarter of a beat in common time.

symbols.name: Thirty second rest
symbols.explanation: Short silence value.

symbols.name: Sixty fourth rest
symbols.explanation: Very short silence value.

symbols.name: Multi measure rest
symbols.explanation: Rest symbol covering several measures.

symbols.name: Treble clef
symbols.explanation: Clef that locates G above middle C on the second line of the staff.

symbols.name: Bass clef
symbols.explanation: Clef that locates F below middle C on the fourth line of the staff.

symbols.name: Alto clef
symbols.explanation: Clef that locates middle C on the third line of the staff.

symbols.name: Tenor clef
symbols.explanation: Clef that locates middle C on the fourth line of the staff.

symbols.name: Percussion clef
symbols.explanation: Clef used for unpitched percussion notation.

symbols.name: Neutral clef
symbols.explanation: Clef indicating rhythmic or non pitched notation.

symbols.name: Sharp
symbols.explanation: Raises the pitch by one semitone.

symbols.name: Flat
symbols.explanation: Lowers the pitch by one semitone.

symbols.name: Natural
symbols.explanation: Cancels a previous sharp or flat.

symbols.name: Double sharp
symbols.explanation: Raises the pitch by two semitones.

symbols.name: Double flat
symbols.explanation: Lowers the pitch by two semitones.

symbols.name: Common time
symbols.explanation: Shorthand symbol for the 4 4 time signature.

symbols.name: Cut time
symbols.explanation: Shorthand symbol for the 2 2 time signature.

symbols.name: Barline
symbols.explanation: Divides the staff into measures.

symbols.name: Double barline
symbols.explanation: Marks the end of a section or change in the music.

symbols.name: Final barline
symbols.explanation: Indicates the end of a piece or movement.

symbols.name: Reverse final barline
symbols.explanation: Marks a strong beginning or entry point.

symbols.name: Start repeat
symbols.explanation: Marks the beginning of a repeated section.

symbols.name: End repeat
symbols.explanation: Marks the end of a repeated section.

symbols.name: Percent repeat sign
symbols.explanation: Repeat the previous bar.

symbols.name: Double percent repeat
symbols.explanation: Repeat the previous two bars.

symbols.name: Fermata
symbols.explanation: Hold the note or rest longer than its written value.

symbols.name: Long fermata
symbols.explanation: Hold significantly longer than a normal fermata.

symbols.name: Very long fermata
symbols.explanation: Hold extremely long often freely.

symbols.name: Short fermata
symbols.explanation: Hold only slightly longer than normal value.

symbols.name: Accent
symbols.explanation: Play the note with a stronger attack.

symbols.name: Marcato
symbols.explanation: Very strong pointed accent on the note.

symbols.name: Staccato
symbols.explanation: Play the note short and detached.

symbols.name: Tenuto
symbols.explanation: Play the note full value or slightly stressed.

symbols.name: Staccatissimo
symbols.explanation: Play the note very short and detached.

symbols.name: Slur
symbols.explanation: Curved line connecting notes to be played smoothly.

symbols.name: Tie
symbols.explanation: Curved line joining two notes of the same pitch to extend duration.

symbols.name: Slur text
symbols.explanation: Describes a curved line connecting notes legato.

symbols.name: Tie text
symbols.explanation: Describes a curved line joining same pitch notes to extend value.

symbols.name: Trill sign
symbols.explanation: Indicates rapid alternation between the written note and a neighbor.

symbols.name: Trill text
symbols.explanation: Text indication for a trill ornament.

symbols.name: Trill symbol
symbols.explanation: Alternate engraved trill marking.

symbols.name: Turn
symbols.explanation: Ornament that circles around the main note.

symbols.name: Inverted turn
symbols.explanation: Turn ornament in inverted order.

symbols.name: Mordent
symbols.explanation: Single rapid alternation with the lower neighbor note.

symbols.name: Inverted mordent
symbols.explanation: Single rapid alternation with the upper neighbor note.

symbols.name: Schleifer
symbols.explanation: Slide or scoop from below into a note.

symbols.name: Breath mark
symbols.explanation: Indicates a small pause or breath.

symbols.name: Caesura
symbols.explanation: Brief complete pause marked like railroad tracks.

symbols.name: Piano
symbols.explanation: Play softly.

symbols.name: Pianissimo
symbols.explanation: Very soft dynamic.

symbols.name: Pianississimo
symbols.explanation: Extremely soft dynamic.

symbols.name: Forté
symbols.explanation: Play loudly.

symbols.name: Fortissimo
symbols.explanation: Very loud dynamic.

symbols.name: Fortississimo
symbols.explanation: Extremely loud dynamic.

symbols.name: Mezzo forte
symbols.explanation: Moderately loud dynamic.

symbols.name: Mezzo piano
symbols.explanation: Moderately soft dynamic.

symbols.name: Sforzando
symbols.explanation: Sudden strong accent on a single note or chord.

symbols.name: Sforzando short
symbols.explanation: Sudden strong accent on note or chord.

symbols.name: Sforzato fortissimo
symbols.explanation: Very strong and sudden accent.

symbols.name: Rinforzando
symbols.explanation: Reinforced accent often for a short passage.

symbols.name: Sforzando piano
symbols.explanation: Strong attack then immediately soft.

symbols.name: Sforzando pianissimo
symbols.explanation: Strong attack then very soft.

symbols.name: niente
symbols.explanation: Dynamics fade to or from almost nothing.

symbols.name: Subito piano
symbols.explanation: Suddenly soft after a louder passage.

symbols.name: Subito forte
symbols.explanation: Suddenly loud after a softer passage.

symbols.name: Crescendo text
symbols.explanation: Gradually get louder indication in text.

symbols.name: Decrescendo text
symbols.explanation: Gradually get softer indication in text.

symbols.name: Crescendo hairpin
symbols.explanation: Graphic sign to gradually get louder.

symbols.name: Decrescendo hairpin
symbols.explanation: Graphic sign to gradually get softer.

symbols.name: Ritardando
symbols.explanation: Gradually slow down the tempo.

symbols.name: Rallentando
symbols.explanation: Broad gradual slowing down.

symbols.name: Accelerando
symbols.explanation: Gradually speed up the tempo.

symbols.name: Stringendo
symbols.explanation: Press forward with increasing tempo.

symbols.name: A tempo
symbols.explanation: Return to the previous tempo.

symbols.name: Rubato
symbols.explanation: Use flexible tempo for expression.

symbols.name: Meno mosso
symbols.explanation: Less movement meaning slower.

symbols.name: Più mosso
symbols.explanation: More movement meaning faster.

symbols.name: Largo
symbols.explanation: Very slow and broad tempo.

symbols.name: Adagio
symbols.explanation: Slow relaxed tempo.

symbols.name: Andante
symbols.explanation: Moderately slow at a walking pace.

symbols.name: Moderato
symbols.explanation: Moderate tempo.

symbols.name: Allegro
symbols.explanation: Fast and lively tempo.

symbols.name: Presto
symbols.explanation: Very fast tempo.

symbols.name: Prestissimo
symbols.explanation: Extremely fast tempo.

symbols.name: Coda
symbols.explanation: Target sign for jumping to a final or special ending section.

symbols.name: Segno
symbols.explanation: Sign used with Dal Segno repeats.

symbols.name: Dal Segno
symbols.explanation: Go back to the Segno sign.

symbols.name: Da Capo
symbols.explanation: Go back to the beginning of the piece.

symbols.name: Fine
symbols.explanation: Indicates the place where the piece ends after a repeat.

symbols.name: Volti subito
symbols.explanation: Turn the page quickly.

symbols.name: Ottava alta
symbols.explanation: Play passage one octave higher than written.

symbols.name: Ottava bassa
symbols.explanation: Play passage one octave lower than written.

symbols.name: Quindicesima alta
symbols.explanation: Play passage two octaves higher than written.

symbols.name: Quindicesima bassa
symbols.explanation: Play passage two octaves lower than written.

symbols.name: Major seventh triangle
symbols.explanation: Symbol for a major seventh chord in jazz notation.

symbols.name: Diminished chord symbol
symbols.explanation: Symbol indicating diminished triad or seventh.

symbols.name: Half diminished symbol
symbols.explanation: Symbol for minor seven flat five chords.

symbols.name: Suspended chord marker
symbols.explanation: Indicates suspended chord where the third is replaced.

symbols.name: Added tone marker
symbols.explanation: Indicates an added scale degree in a chord.

symbols.name: Altered chord marker
symbols.explanation: Indicates altered chord tensions in jazz harmony.

symbols.name: No tone marker
symbols.explanation: Indicates a specific chord tone is omitted.

symbols.name: Augmented marker
symbols.explanation: Indicates augmented fifth or similar alteration.

symbols.name: Cross notehead
symbols.explanation: Used for unpitched or special sounds like percussion or spoken.

symbols.name: Diamond notehead
symbols.explanation: Used for harmonics and special tone colors.

symbols.name: Square notehead
symbols.explanation: Used in some percussion or contemporary notation.

symbols.name: Black circle notehead
symbols.explanation: Alternative filled notehead in some scores.

symbols.name: Pizzicato
symbols.explanation: Pluck the string instead of bowing.

symbols.name: Arco
symbols.explanation: Play with the bow after pizzicato.

symbols.name: Bartok pizzicato
symbols.explanation: Very strong pizzicato snapping the string to the fingerboard.

symbols.name: Sul tasto
symbols.explanation: Play over the fingerboard for a softer tone.

symbols.name: Sul ponticello
symbols.explanation: Play near the bridge for bright nasal tone.

symbols.name: Con sordino
symbols.explanation: Play with a mute.

symbols.name: Senza sordino
symbols.explanation: Play without mute.

symbols.name: Col legno
symbols.explanation: Strike the string with the wood of the bow.

symbols.name: Tremolo
symbols.explanation: Rapid repetition or alternation for a trembling effect.

symbols.name: Pedal mark
symbols.explanation: Indicates that the sustain pedal should be pressed.

symbols.name: Pedal release
symbols.explanation: Indicates the sustain pedal should be released.

symbols.name: Una corda
symbols.explanation: Press the soft pedal on piano for a quieter tone.

symbols.name: Tre corde
symbols.explanation: Release the soft pedal and return to normal tone.

symbols.name: Parentheses around note
symbols.explanation: Indicate optional or editorial note.

symbols.name: Brackets
symbols.explanation: Used for editorial notes or grouping.

symbols.name: Brace
symbols.explanation: Connects multiple staves for one instrument or system.

symbols.name: Grand staff bracket
symbols.explanation: Represents treble and bass clef bracket for piano system.

symbols.name: Rimshot
symbols.explanation: Strike rim and head of drum together.

symbols.name: Cross stick
symbols.explanation: Stick laid across drum and struck for a click sound.

symbols.name: Open articulation
symbols.explanation: Play cymbal or hi hat open.

symbols.name: Choked cymbal
symbols.explanation: Grab cymbal after strike for short sound.

symbols.name: General MIDI mark
symbols.explanation: Indicates use of General MIDI standard in some contexts.

symbols.name: Maelzels metronome
symbols.explanation: Indicates metronome marking for tempo.

symbols.name: Metronome mark example
symbols.explanation: Quarter note equals sixty beats per minute.

symbols.name: Simile
symbols.explanation: Continue in the same way as previously indicated.
